title: TravelBlog
guideIntro: You're testing a travel content site. Browse the homepage, read an article, and try the contact form.

bugs.title: Navigation links fail contrast check
bugs.description: Nav links use #b0b0b0 on a #ffffff background — contrast ratio 2.6:1, well below the 4.5:1 WCAG AA minimum.
bugs.remediation: Darken the nav link color to at least #595959 (contrast 7:1).
bugs.guideHint: Squint at the text colors — can you read everything easily?

bugs.title: Heading skips from h1 to h3
bugs.description: The page title is <h1> but the next heading is <h3>, skipping <h2>. Screen reader users lose the document outline.
bugs.remediation: Change <h3> to <h2> for top-level section headings.
bugs.guideHint: Check the heading structure — does it flow logically?

bugs.title: Read more link is broken
bugs.description: The second article's 'Read more' link points to href="#broken", which does not navigate to any valid page.
bugs.remediation: Set href to "article.html" to link to the full article.
bugs.guideHint: Click every link — do they all go somewhere?

bugs.title: Article hero image missing alt
bugs.description: The main article photo has no alt attribute. Screen readers announce it as an unnamed image.
bugs.remediation: Add alt="Sunset over Santorini caldera with white buildings and blue domes".
bugs.guideHint: Look for images that a screen reader can't describe

bugs.title: Sidebar overlaps article text
bugs.description: The sidebar has position:absolute with a left value that causes it to overlap the main article content, making both unreadable.
bugs.remediation: Use a CSS grid or flexbox layout to place the sidebar next to the content.
bugs.guideHint: Watch for elements sitting on top of each other

bugs.title: Message textarea missing label
bugs.description: The message textarea uses placeholder text but has no associated <label>. Screen readers announce it as an unlabeled field.
bugs.remediation: Add <label for="message">Your message</label> before the textarea.
bugs.guideHint: Tab through the form — does every field announce itself?

bugs.title: Back to home link is broken
bugs.description: The 'Back to homepage' link has href="#" and does not navigate anywhere.
bugs.guideHint: Click every link — do they all go somewhere?
